name: Dimensionado preliminar de desagües de condensados

method.gravity_capacity: Manning equation for a half-full circular smooth pipe, with only 25 percent used as design capacity

limitations: Not a certificate or automatic proof of regulatory compliance
The 25 percent usable-capacity factor is a conservative engineering reserve, not a statutory value
Manufacturer drain connection is always a minimum
Pumps, siphons, air breaks, cleaning access and local wastewater rules require project review
Direct manufacturer or measured condensate flow should replace estimates
